name: Futaba Yuiri
source:
A first year in the school who's in the same class as [url=/c55364]Mayuri[/url]. She looks up to [url=/c47238]Souji[/url] who's very reliable, and fondly calls him "onii-san". She is also an old acquaintance because she was Mayuri's friend when they lived in another city in the past.

Her father has remarried and she has a new family. She strongly looks up to her older step sister [url=/c40164]Saki[/url] who is great at all sports, has great grades and is the club president of the tennis club. She always follows her sister while going all "onee-chan, onee-chan", putting her older sister off a little.

However, Yuiri acts very shy towards everyone except for her older sister, and wants to become more assertive... ending up going a little berserk, then happens to immediately be at her wits' end.
